newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's trade surplus seen rising in December.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's trade surplus seen rising in December.

text.p: Indonesia's trade surplus is likely to rise to $916.2 million in December from $764.6 million in November, government sources said on Tuesday.
They said the total trade surplus for 1996 was seen at $6.95 billion.
"Our economic development is very good in 1996 as we can see it in our trade figures," one source said.
The figures are to be officially announced after a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
According to the sources, total exports in December rose to $4.68 billion from $4.41 billion in November. Imports rose to $3.77 billion from $3.64 billion.
Total exports in 1996 rose to $49.82 billion from $45.42 billion in 1995. Imports in 1996 rose to $42.87 billion from $40.63 billion.
